sections.title: Kill Credit — The 10-Level Rule
lines: A kill counts if the target is at most 10 levels below you, or any level above you
A kill does not count if the target is more than 10 levels below you
The card states the rule outright, and it is the reason a high-level player farming low-level targets makes no progress:

The same 10-level gap governs the [[Crime System]], where landing the death blow on a player more than 10 levels below you in a Danger Zone or War Zone is what generates Crime. The two rules point the same way: the game neither rewards nor tolerates farming players far beneath you.

Three variants have been captured, one per major village:
The first three cards read Lv. 50+ Daily Mission and carry the same title, so the destination is rolled when the mission is offered rather than being three separately named missions.

[[Takumi Village]] was captured on 17 August 2026, closing the gap this page previously declared. sections.title: There Is A Countdown
lines: The tracked panel shows a stopwatch reading 30:52 beside the title, alongside an Abandon button.

What the clock measures is not confirmed. It is recorded here as the card draws it. A completion time limit is the natural reading for an escort mission with a fail condition, but it could equally be a tracking or reset timer, and the wiki does not publish the guess as fact. If you have run this and watched the clock hit zero, that settles it — see [[Nin Online Wiki:Contributing]].
Either way, no other mission card captured for this wiki shows a timer at all, which makes this the first recorded instance of one.

lines: 1 - On top of the main wall, north of the scroll shop

This is the one village where that is true — in [[Leaf Village|Leaf]], [[Sand Village|Sand]] and [[Mist Village|Mist]] a seal released before you hold the mission still counts retroactively, so players routinely route through an enemy village first. Speak to [[Yuu]] in front of the Takumi hospital to start it, then release all seven:
Then head to the Tomb of Royalty on the ridge north of the scroll shop, go inside, and return to [[Yuu]].
The rest of the chain — the cave, the ghosts and the spirit boss — is written up at [[Yuu Mini Questline]].

The mobsters will ask for 2 sake bottles from you to allow entrance into their hideout, but luckly for you, the Kinsen bar is close by, with each bottle being 30 Ryo. Giving Pedro the bottles alows you to progress on the mission to defeat mobster, but be careful since they are faster than most enemies you find on your journey. sections.title: Story
lines: Inside the memory the player meets the corruptor for the first time, who reveals that four lieutenants serve him: "my breeze, my melody, my arrow, and my fists." These are the four Sound Bosses hunted in [[Break the Chain]].
Lady Kitsune (giving the fragment)
I said I may have something.
This is a fragment of memory…
Not mine, but the land's. It has been surfacing near the village for years now, as if something buried is trying to be remembered.
I cannot see what is inside it. But you are an outsider, and sometimes the land shows strangers what it will not show those who live within it.
When you are ready… look into it.
The Memory Fragment
The fragment hovers before you, pulsing faintly, warm, almost breathing. Images flicker at the edges of your vision, half-formed, pulling at you.
What do you do?
??? (the corruptor)
An outsider. Inside a memory that was not meant to be found.

You can do only 1 gambling mission at a time, to do the other gambling mission you need to COMPLETE the 1st one you picked.

missions.summary: This is a walkthrough of the chain [[Yuu]] starts in [[Takumi Village]], in the Land of Rivers. The mission itself, its rewards and the seven seal locations are on [[Hidden Tomb - (Takumi Seals)]]; this page carries the rest of it.
